checks.name: Guide coverage
checks.output: All six required guide families exist: clean-room porting, state machines, security boundaries, naming, test preservation and metrics. The manifest binds 18 enforceable rules to existing permitted source documents and generated guide digests.

checks.name: Objective schema
checks.output: The closed schema requires objective ID/work ID, objective, metric, baseline, budget, tests, stop conditions, hill-climbability, eligibility, allowed paths, licence and sources. Metric, baseline and budget subfields are also required.

checks.name: Runnable coverage
checks.output: All six runnable nodes in the pre-completion DAG had valid objectives. The manifest contains 15 contracted objectives; missing baselines remain null with a reason until an immutable loop attempt measures them.

checks.name: Low-score refusal
checks.output: A synthetic score of 69 with eligibility true was rejected at the configured threshold of 70. The live selector also refused BOOT-002 at score 60 while retaining it in the objective manifest.

checks.name: Contradictions
checks.output: An injected require/forbid conflict failed with both the original generated guide location and fixture/opposite.md#opposite.

checks.name: Reproducibility
checks.output: Two in-memory generations of all 10 guide/objective/config artifacts were byte-identical and every committed generated byte matched.

extra_checks.name: Bounded loop policy
extra_checks.output: The loop tests cover deterministic admission, low-score refusal, exact path leases, explicit argv, single-worker locking, Bubblewrap isolation, unchanged/failure/iteration/wall stops and candidate-only success.

extra_checks.name: Existing CI test entry point
extra_checks.output: 29 tests passed through the existing CI entry point: 14 DAG/topology tests, 6 guide/objective tests and 9 loop tests.

extra_checks.name: Loop inspection
extra_checks.command: python3 tools/harness_loop.py next --item R0-04 && python3 tools/harness_loop.py status
extra_checks.output: R0-04 resolved to a score-92 bounded objective with its six checks and four explicit stop conditions; unused loop state reported idle.

notes: The loop is proposal-only and defaults to inspection. Execution requires an explicit argv local worker, a clean tree and Bubblewrap. The worker receives no network, home, environment credentials or Git metadata and can write only existing leased paths. Output is not persisted. Provider-backed agents remain deferred to R0-06/R0-19. A zero worker exit produces a candidate diff, not completion evidence.
